facts.activity_file: assessing and permitting hot work adjacent to live plant

control_failures.control_label: atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work
integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: corrective action - critical safeguard at K-7301

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control GAS_TEST_BEFORE_AND_DURING_HOT_WORK: the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work on K-7301, M-7301 and TT-7301 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising hot work, specifically assessing and permitting hot work adjacent to live plant. K-7301 (vapour recovery compressor) is in service for loading vapour recovery. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 9 January 2010 a corrective action on K-7301, M-7301 and TT-7301 at Cape Verity Export Terminal was reviewed against the critical safeguard it was raised to restore.
